_note: At The Podium. Talks and topics are from Kardi's Speakers Canada profile; edit freely. 'dates' are speaking engagements (future under Upcoming, past under Recent). 'stages' are notable past stages with links where public.
intro: Twenty-five years of making records, signing artists and building culture, told from the inside. He speaks the way he raps: direct, funny, and about something.

talks.title: The Art of Staying Original
talks.body: How to keep a voice of your own through trends, labels and algorithms. From Eye & I to Vol. 2.

talks.title: Building Culture Through Collaboration
talks.body: Akon, Idris Elba, T-Pain, a city of kids with demos. What real collaboration costs and returns.

talks.title: Representation, Power and Purpose
talks.body: Being the first Canadian rapper in the Hot 100's top five, and what you do with the door once it opens.

talks.title: Developing the Next Generation of Creators
talks.body: Lessons from the A&R desk at Universal and Def Jam on finding, backing and not breaking young talent.

talks.title: Reinvention and Longevity in the Creative Era
talks.body: Rapper, producer, executive, judge, host. Staying useful for three decades without becoming a cover band of yourself.

stages.title: Red Bull Music Academy lecture
stages.detail: A long-form conversation on the making of a Canadian hip-hop career.
